name: cash.credit_lines

list.description: Read native credit line settings and account member configurations.

purpose: Inspect native credit limits, validity, status and account membership without changing settings.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Native credit line limit; amount representation and currency remain unchanged.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Native credit line currency; distinct from member account currency.

fields.name: bankAccountCreditLineList
fields.meaning: Unmodified native account configuration and parent links.

identity_description: Native string or integer id, preserving identity types; nested members use parent id and member id.
limitations: Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, native GET with rowStart offsets and pageSize=100; no arbitrary filters or detail action.
Both outer count and result.count must agree; duplicate identities, changing totals and malformed envelopes fail.
Full native records retain unknown fields, null, empty text and exact amounts. Legacy whitelist field loss is corrected; no amount scaling, arithmetic or member aggregation.
Shared account flags are source values; no inferred limits or currency conversion.
Settings interpretation focuses on configuration fields. Other native source fields are retained without deriving usage or treating configuration timestamps as usage observation times.
